acceptance expires. Read by BOTH CVE gates through

An entry is not a fix. It is a dated decision to ship a known defect, and it
STOPS BEING ONE on its expiry date: scripts/utils/vuln_acceptance.py refuses
an expired entry rather than ignoring it, so the gate goes red again and the
decision is retaken by a person instead of inherited by silence.
